meta.name: ptp-razor-planner
meta.description: Activate this persona during detailed architectural planning, or specifically during Phase 4 (Detailed Execution Plan) of a parcel plan to ruthlessly enforce the Simplicity Ladder, reject speculative scope, and produce surgically precise file-level blueprints.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 做架构规划时严控范围,产出可落地的文件级蓝图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做大型项目时需要先想清楚代码结构和边界再动手。
copy.tagline_en: Enforce simplicity and reject scope creep while planning file-level blueprints.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design a clear code structure before starting a large project.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在制定详细执行计划时会强制套用「简洁阶梯」,逐条砍掉投机和多余抽象;产出包含文件路径、代码片段、复用记录、测试验证的精简执行蓝图;对含糊或臃肿的计划会直接要求重写。
howto.when: 当你在做详细架构规划,或在 pass-the-parcel 流程的第 4 阶段(详细执行计划)时触发;也可用 `/razor` 命令主动调用,用于收紧既有计划。

say.text: 请用简洁阶梯审查这份执行计划,删掉投机范围,只留必要步骤。
say.note: Claude 会逐项检查并砍掉无法证明必要的内容。

say.text: 用 /razor 把整个计划精简到最少文件、最短 diff。
say.note: 触发独立计划收紧模式。

say.text: 在 Phase 4 输出文件级蓝图,每步都要可独立执行。
say.note: Claude 会产出带路径、测试验证的精简蓝图。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude enforces the Simplicity Ladder during detailed execution planning, cuts speculative scope and abstractions, and outputs file-level blueprints with snippets, wiki citations, and test steps. It rejects vague or bloated plans.
howto.when_en: Triggered during detailed architectural planning, or Phase 4 (Detailed Execution Plan) of a parcel plan, or via the /razor command for standalone plan hardening.

say_en.text: Review this execution plan with the Simplicity Ladder and cut speculative scope.
say_en.note: Claude will check each step and remove unjustified items.

say_en.text: Use /razor to trim this plan to the fewest files and shortest diff.
Produce a file-level Phase 4 blueprint; each step independently executable.
say_en.note: Output includes paths, snippets, and verification steps.
